trust_decision.summary: PE::_parse_debug decides whether an IMAGE_DEBUG_MISC record's DbgFile string (from file-controlled Length/Unicode) is accepted as debug->Filename; at the pinned commit it uses utils readers that accept unterminated or invalid UTF-16 strings and skips both the parity check and the read for Unicode values other than 0/1.

landing_point.why: The summary names pe.cpp _parse_debug; the IMAGE_DEBUG_MISC branch with the Length subtraction is the obvious place to look.

fix_sites.entry_point: public API mana::PE::PE(path) / PE::create_from_bytes -> _initialize -> _parse_directories -> _parse_debug (manape/pe.cpp:1031); CLI via manalyze dump debug (src/dump.cpp:402)
new file-local helper read_bounded_utf16_string, reached only from the MISC branch (fix.diff:82-84)
fix_sites.module_kind: core PE parser, file-local helper replacing utils::read_unicode_string (manape/utils.cpp:49)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The fix leaves the shared lower-level reader utils::read_unicode_string (manape/utils.cpp:49-79) untouched and adds a local helper instead; there is no second fix site in another module.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No uncovered route reaches debug->Filename: CodeView is already bounded (manape/pe.cpp:733-734). The only plausible dismissal is treating Unicode values other than 0/1 as 'malformed, ignore' rather than the boolean the fix makes them.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: utils::read_unicode_string/read_ascii_string are shared by resource version-info, import names and COFF parsing with max_bytes=0 (unbounded) semantics, so hardening the shared utils readers (e.g. failing when no terminator is found) changes those parsers. Valid bounded MISC records must still parse ('L'/'LE'), and a malformed MISC entry must be skipped without dropping a later valid CodeView sibling.

O6_input_shapes: ASCII MISC string not terminated within Length (fix.diff:119-131)
UTF-16 MISC string not terminated within Length (fix.diff:133-148)
UTF-16 MISC string with an invalid surrogate (fix.diff:159-174)
Unicode flag set to a nonzero value other than 1, treated as boolean (fix.diff:63-67, fix.diff:150-157)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: COFF string table loop calls unbounded utils::read_ascii_string, so the last string can run past st_size
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It is real code at the pinned commit; the in-repo design doc (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-26-parser-boundary-safety-design.md:71-75) says COFF strings must terminate within the payload, so a maintainer could plausibly have fixed the debug case and left this one.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: VS_VERSION_INFO Key read with unbounded utils::read_unicode_string, not limited to the structure's Length
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same reader pattern that the MISC fix replaced; design doc lines 77-81 call for resource-relative bounds on version-info reads.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: StringTable value read with unbounded read_unicode_string after only a coarse ftell < Length check
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same how-type mechanism (string must terminate within its declared extent) in another file; a maintainer focused on _parse_debug would not touch resources.cpp.

O9_family: declared-boundary / integer underflow in length-bounded string parsing (CWE-189/191); the fix enforces termination and validity of strings within the declared MISC Length

O10_build.toolchain: CMake >= 3.12, C++ compiler, Boost (unit_test_framework; system optional), optional OpenSSL; yara and hash-library are git-cloned into external/ at configure time (CMakeLists.txt:114-118)
O10_build.project_tests: Boost.Test suite test/pe.cpp, with MISC cases at test/pe.cpp:417-489 and helper make_debug_misc_pe at test/pe.cpp:84; built as manalyze-tests (test/CMakeLists.txt:8)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Tighten the Length arithmetic check at manape/pe.cpp:765-766 only, or change utils::read_unicode_string globally, missing the unterminated or invalid-UTF-16 rejection and the Unicode!=0 boolean case.

out_of_scope_notes: COFF string table (manape/pe.cpp:473-488) and version-info string reads (manape/resources.cpp:385, manape/resources.cpp:689) use unbounded readers even though the in-repo design doc calls for bounds; this is the same mechanism but a different advisory scope.
Build clones yara and hash-library from GitHub at configure time (CMakeLists.txt:114-118); vendor them for an offline image.
unverified: The exact integer underflow the CVE title refers to is not evident at the pinned commit: Length is already checked before subtraction (manape/pe.cpp:765). The fix's real change is termination, UTF-16 validity and Unicode-flag handling.
Recall risk rated low by assumption: the advisory appears to belong to a recent fork-local hardening series; no external write-ups checked.
Whether a Unicode value other than 0/1 should count as UTF-16 (the fix's choice) or be rejected is a judgement a hidden test encodes (fix.diff:150-157), which may be unfair to solvers who reject it.
